source_row.rationale: Advance care planning is important in advanced, decompensated cirrhosis because this condition often carries significant symptom burden and unpredictable complications (such as variceal bleeding or hepatic encephalopathy), making proactive conversations about values and preferences valuable, whether or not the client is a transplant candidate.
